Package io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.service

Class EventRegisterService

java.lang.Object
io.telekom.orchest.enginecore.bpmn.service.EventRegisterService
public class EventRegisterService extends Object
Coordinator for event registration across all event types. Delegates event-specific operations to TimerEventRegistrar, MessageEventRegistrar, and SignalEventRegistrar. Directly manages worker registry and pending task operations.
